summary: The notebook currently holds two notes: a course note on gradient descent for ML foundations and a reading note on the Transformer paper.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: One course note covers gradient descent: the update rule, a one-step quadratic example, and learning-rate failure modes.
areas.gap: Only the first note of the ml-foundations course exists; momentum, Adam, and other optimization topics are not yet covered.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: A reading note covers the Transformer architecture: scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, and its design trade-offs.
areas.gap: No notes yet on sub-quadratic attention variants, positional encoding improvements, or training-stability recipes that followed the paper.
